svg.aria-label: How inbound and outbound stacks are composed
svg.title: How inbound and outbound stacks are composed

g.text: chooses an outbound for each request
the accept loop goes straight back
per connection, in its own goroutine,
in stack order, after the base dials,
Below the proxy client, an address means the
proxy server. Above it, it means the real
no proxy client and no overlays
the address the client asked for
A stack is written base first, for example "transport": [{"type": "tcp"}, {"type": "tls"}, {"type": "ws"}]. Only the base makes a dialer or listener; each overlay wraps
one connection at a time. Outbound: ws.WrapClientStream(tls.WrapClientStream(tcp DialStream(server))). Inbound: the same order per accepted connection.
